data.body_html:
Plan the ultimate Marbella family boat day jetski snorkel paddleboard combo 2030 – a full day of water fun departing from Puerto Banús. Whether you want to zoom across the Mediterranean on a jetski, explore underwater life with a snorkel, or glide on a paddleboard along the Costa del Sol, this private charter has it all. Prices start from €749 for a 2-hour trip and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and VAT. No hidden costs, just pure family time on the water.

What the Family Boat Day Combo Includes

Every charter comes with a professional skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The combo adds a jetski session (on Tier B boats), snorkel masks, and a paddleboard. You don't need any experience – the skipper will guide you. For families with kids aged 5+, this is the easiest way to enjoy multiple water activities in one day.

Which Boats Are Available for the Combo

For the standard combo (without jetski), we recommend the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús. If you want a jetski included, book a Mangusta 80 or Mangusta 80 Grey (24m, 12 pax) from €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours. For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) are available on request.

Pricing: Transparent and All Inclusive

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. For other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp. No surprises.

Where You'll Go: Best Spots for Snorkel & Paddleboard

Departing from Puerto Banús, your skipper will suggest a route based on sea conditions. Popular family stops include Cala del Faro – a rocky cove with clear water perfect for snorkeling. Cala Cortés offers calm, shallow waters ideal for paddleboarding. You can also cruise to Cabopino beach or head toward Estepona for a longer trip. The skipper knows the best spots for each activity.

Jetski, Snorkel & Paddleboard: How It Works

On Tier B boats, the jetski is included free and supervised by the skipper. Kids aged 12+ can ride with an adult. Snorkel gear is provided for all ages – masks, fins, and snorkels. Paddleboards are stable and easy to use; the skipper will give basic instructions. You can rotate activities throughout the day – jetski for 20 minutes, then snorkel, then paddleboard. It's flexible and family-focused.

What to Bring and What to Expect

Bring swimsuits, towels, sunscreen (reef-safe), sunglasses, a hat, and a light jacket. We provide all drinks and snacks. If you want to bring your own food, let us know. The water temperature in Marbella averages 22°C in summer, so wetsuits aren't needed. Life jackets are available for non-swimmers. The boat has a shaded cabin and a sun deck – plenty of space for the family to relax between activities.

Book Your Family Boat Day for 2030

Secure your Marbella family boat day jetski snorkel paddleboard combo 2030 by contacting us via WhatsApp or through our website. We recommend booking at least one week in advance, especially in July and August. All charters are private – just your family and the skipper. Customize the itinerary on the day. For more ideas, check our Marbella boat charter hub.
